newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Kloof fire extinguished, output loss minimal.
newsitem.headline: Kloof fire extinguished, output loss minimal.

text.p: Kloof Gold Mining Co Ltd said on Monday a fire 2,800 metres underground had been extinguished and production losses from the affected area were expected to be minimal.
The fire was detected in the 21 Longwall on August 13 and contained.
The area affected was served by the No 3 Sub-Vertical shaft and contributed about 10 percent of Kloof's underground ore production, the company said in a statement.
"Further losses of production from this area are expected to be minimal," it said.
Kloof produced 9,877.7 kg of gold in the three months to end-June.
